attacks.name: Mental Shackle
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
After this attack is resolved, if it dealt |!damage|, this character may Advance the defender |!movement_small|.
|!wild| |*Root|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§root§Root| special condition.

attacks.name: Astral Disintegration
steps: Add dice to the attack roll equal to the amount of |!power| the target character has, to a maximum of 5.
The defender cannot reroll or modify dice in the defense roll during this attack.

superPowers.name: Astral Fiend
superPowers.body: |*Action|: Place a |<projection-king>Projection| token within |!range| 3 of this character. When measuring |!range| for this character's attacks or superpowers, measure from the Projection token. When measuring |!range| for enemy |!mystic| attacks, enemy characters may measure to this character or its Projection token. When this character is dealt |!damage| by an enemy |!mystic| attack, remove this token. At the beginning of the |*Cleanup Phase|, remove this token. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Immortal Essence
superPowers.body: This character removes up to 3 |!damage| from itself. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Nightmare Visions
superPowers.body: When a character ends an Advance within |!range| 3 of this character, this character may use this superpower. Roll 4 dice. The enemy character suffers 1 |!damage| for each |!critical| and |!wild| in the result. If this superpower deals at least 1 |!damage|, this character may Advance the enemy character |!movement_small|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Omega Level Multi-Versal Entity
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 1 additional |!power|.
